import socket, struct, time

# Connect to SITL on its receive port and listen for responses
s = socket.socket\(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM\)
s.settimeout\(3\)
s.bind\(\('127.0.0.1', 14555\)\)

# Send a minimal MAVLink2 heartbeat to SITL \(this triggers it to learn our address\)
# MAVLink2 heartbeat: fd 09 00 00 00 ff be 00 00 00 ...
heartbeat = bytearray\([
    0xfd,       # MAVLink2 magic
    0x09,       # payload len
    0x00, 0x00, # incompat/compat flags
    0x00,       # sequence
    0xff,       # sysid \(GCS=255\)
    0xbe,       # compid \(190\)
    0x00, 0x00, 0x00,  # msgid=0 \(HEARTBEAT\)
    # payload: type=6\(GCS\), autopilot=8\(INVALID\), base_mode=0, custom=0, status=0
    0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,  # custom_mode
    0x06,       # type = MAV_TYPE_GCS
    0x08,       # autopilot = MAV_AUTOPILOT_INVALID
    0x00,       # base_mode
    0x00,       # system_status
    0x03,       # mavlink_version
]\)
# Add CRC \(simplified - just send and see\)
s.sendto\(heartbeat, \('127.0.0.1', 14540\)\)
print\('Sent heartbeat to SITL on 14540'\)

# Wait for response
try:
    data, addr = s.recvfrom\(1024\)
    print\(f'Received {len\(data\)} bytes from {addr}'\)
    print\(f'First bytes: {data[:20].hex\(\)}'\)
except socket.timeout:
    print\('TIMEOUT - no response from SITL'\)
s.close\(\)
" 2>&1)

import struct

# The rx_buf starts at 0x2400221F \(dummy byte at [0], data at [1..12]\)
# But we're reading 12 bytes starting at 0x24002220 which is rx_buf[1..12]
# These are the accel+gyro data bytes in SPI read order

# Read 1: 51 03 93 09 2B 00 03 08 DC 19 E3 FF
# Read 2: 3F 03 86 09 2A 00 05 08 E2 19 E1 FF
# But stored as little-endian 32-bit words, need to extract bytes

def parse_imu\(word0, word1, word2, label\):
    # Convert 32-bit words to byte array \(little-endian\)
    data = struct.pack\('<III', word0, word1, word2\)
    # data = [AX_H, AX_L, AY_H, AY_L, AZ_H, AZ_L, GX_H, GX_L, GY_H, GY_L, GZ_H, GZ_L]
    ax = struct.unpack\('>h', bytes\([data[0], data[1]]\)\)[0]
    ay = struct.unpack\('>h', bytes\([data[2], data[3]]\)\)[0]
    az = struct.unpack\('>h', bytes\([data[4], data[5]]\)\)[0]
    gx = struct.unpack\('>h', bytes\([data[6], data[7]]\)\)[0]
    gy = struct.unpack\('>h', bytes\([data[8], data[9]]\)\)[0]
    gz = struct.unpack\('>h', bytes\([data[10], data[11]]\)\)[0]
    
    ACCEL_SCALE = 9.80665 / 2048.0  # m/s^2 per LSB \(±16g\)
    GYRO_SCALE = \(3.14159265 / 180.0\) / 16.4  # rad/s per LSB \(±2000 dps\)
    
    ax_mps2 = ax * ACCEL_SCALE
    ay_mps2 = ay * ACCEL_SCALE
    az_mps2 = az * ACCEL_SCALE
    gx_rads = gx * GYRO_SCALE
    gy_rads = gy * GYRO_SCALE
    gz_rads = gz * GYRO_SCALE
    
    import math
    total_g = math.sqrt\(ax_mps2**2 + ay_mps2**2 + az_mps2**2\) / 9.80665
    
    print\(f"--- {label} ---"\)
    print\(f"  Accel: X={ax_mps2:+7.2f}  Y={ay_mps2:+7.2f}  Z={az_mps2:+7.2f} m/s²  \(|a| = {total_g:.2f} g\)"\)
    print\(f"  Gyro:  X={gx_rads:+7.4f}  Y={gy_rads:+7.4f}  Z={gz_rads:+7.4f} rad/s"\)
    print\(f"  Gyro:  X={gx_rads*180/3.14159:+7.2f}  Y={gy_rads*180/3.14159:+7.2f}  Z={gz_rads*180/3.14159:+7.2f} deg/s"\)

# Read 1 words \(little-endian\): 0x51039309 0x2B000308 0xDC19E3FF
parse_imu\(0x51039309, 0x2B000308, 0xDC19E3FF, "Read 1"\)
print\(\)
# Read 2 words: 0x3F038609 0x2A000508 0xE219E1FF
parse_imu\(0x3F038609, 0x2A000508, 0xE219E1FF, "Read 2"\)
PYEOF)
